{{Top|leg}}
'''Norufu''' was a [[Near-Human]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] of [[Stenness Node]]-based [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Norufu served as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of Bogga's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Enforcer One (dreadnaught)|''Enforcer One'']].
